items.title: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
items.description: Further details have emerged about two police officers hailed for preventing a Polish gunman from killing more.

items.title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
items.description: Several carriages derailed after two trains travelling in the same direction crashed outside the city of Giza.

items.title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali
items.description: Millions of Indians are marking the festival of lights with glowing lamps, fireworks and traditional sweets.

items.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
items.description: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.

items.title: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes
items.description: Footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows damage to the building in the capital's central financial district.

items.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
items.description: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

items.title: Paraguay's former president charged after bank collapse
items.description: Santiago Peña was ousted due to a banking crisis which left millions of people unable to access their money.

items.title: Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
items.description: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

items.title: Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data
items.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.

items.title: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
items.description: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.

items.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
items.description: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

items.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge
items.description: The 82-year-old appeared in court in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.
